title: Lipocalin-2-mediated intestinal epithelial cells pyroptosis via NF-kappaB/NLRP3/GSDMD signaling axis adversely affects inflammation in colitis.
authors: Yang, Yuyi; Li, Sheng; Liu, Ke; Zhang, Yin; Zhu, Fangqing; Ben, Teng; Chen, Zheng; Zhi, Fachao
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Lipocalin-2通过NF-kappaB/NLRP3/GSDMD信号轴介导肠上皮细胞焦亡在结肠炎中的作用，属于纯湿实验和信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a major inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) characterized by intestinal epithelium damage. Recently, Lipocalin-2 (LCN2) has been identified as a potential fecal biomarker for patients with UC. However, further investigation is required to explore its pro-inflammatory role in UC and the underlying mechanism. The biological analysis revealed that Lcn2 serves as a putative signature gene in the colon mucosa of patients with UC and its association with the capsase/pyroptosis signaling pathway in UC. In wild-type mice with DSS-induced colitis, LCN2 overexpression in colon mucosa via in vivo administration of Lcn2 overexpression plasmid resulted in exacerbation of colitis symptoms and epithelium damage, as well as increased expression levels of pyroptosis markers (cleaved caspase1, GSDMD, IL-1beta, HMGB1 and IL-18). Additionally, we observed downregulation in the expression levels of pyroptosis markers following in vivo silencing of LCN2. However, the pro-inflammatory effect of LCN2 overexpression was effectively restrained in GSDMD-KO mice. Moreover, single-cell RNA-sequencing analysis revealed that Lcn2 was predominantly expressed in the intestinal epithelial cells (IECs) within the colon mucosa of patients with UC. We found that LCN2 effectively regulated pyroptosis events by modulating the NF-kappaB/NLRP3/GSDMD signaling axis in NCM460 cells stimulated by LPS and ATP. These findings demonstrate the pro-inflammatory role of LCN2 in colon epithelium and provide a potential target for inhibiting pyroptosis in UC.
abstract_zh: 溃疡性结肠炎（UC）是一种以肠道上皮损伤为特征的主要炎症性肠病（IBD）。近期，脂质运载蛋白-2（LCN2）已被确定为UC患者的潜在粪便生物标志物。然而，仍需进一步研究以探讨其在UC中的促炎作用及其潜在机制。生物学分析显示，Lcn2在UC患者结肠黏膜中作为推定特征基因，并与UC中的caspase/焦亡信号通路相关。在经DSS诱导结肠炎的野生型小鼠中，通过体内给予Lcn2过表达质粒使结肠黏膜中LCN2过表达，导致结肠炎症状和上皮损伤加重，同时焦亡标志物（cleaved caspase1、GSDMD、IL-1beta、HMGB1和IL-18）表达水平升高。此外，我们观察到体内沉默LCN2后焦亡标志物表达水平下调。然而，LCN2过表达的促炎效应在GSDMD-KO小鼠中受到有效抑制。进一步地，单细胞RNA测序分析显示，Lcn2在UC患者结肠黏膜的肠上皮细胞（IECs）中主要表达。我们发现，LCN2通过调节LPS和ATP刺激的NCM460细胞中NF-kappaB/NLRP3/GSDMD信号轴，有效调控焦亡事件。这些发现证明了LCN2在结肠上皮中的促炎作用，并为抑制UC中的焦亡提供了潜在靶点。
